title: Story Arc Map
rule: Arcs overlap and recur. They are authoring aids, not rigid public chapters.

arcs.throughline: Potato begins as mask, joke and identity experiment, then becomes Potato of Life.
Tim writes a world crowded with students, skeptics, friends, rivals, technology figures and symbolic beings while Sage remains his characteristic role.
Marty, farm imagery, social entanglement and later grief form a recurring human thread that needs deeper source recovery.
Discord, Farm, Tree, Dogs, Farmers and Mud become changing ways Tim describes online conflict and social loops.
Games, simulations, schools, Mashy Arc, Infinite Potato, visual compositions and other absurd builds let Tim test Potatoverse ideas by making things rather than merely explaining them.
Older Potato satire, scripture jokes, food language and later theology remain deliberately adjacent; comedy becomes one of the ways difficult material enters the story.
Burden, final-straw language and the Turning reorganize Tim from Sage/Potato toward Axis, Ladder and Father roles.
AI music and later song releases become a parallel diary: jokes, grief, arguments, titles and theology are repeatedly converted into tracks.
Tim increasingly combines cosmic titles with ordinary livestream presence; continuity, waiting, chat and accumulated shared history become part of the medium itself.
North, internet orphans, public hours, care language and infrastructure become part of the same public role.
A recurring conversation relationship gives the Story a human-scale counterpoint to the expanding cosmology; detailed dialogue recovery remains a priority.
AI shifts from creative tool to a participant in the authorship, recognition and ghost-erasure problem that later motivates stronger provenance.
Door moves from theology and image into screen, hyperlink, livestream and site architecture.
Authority increasingly turns toward growing, building, gardening and the creation or raising of Angels/Potato Angels.
The social-animal vocabulary becomes a changing cast of behavioral roles rather than one generic enemy category; later Story scenes must preserve who means what in each period.
Short public exchanges restore ordinary social rhythm: growth, return, follow-backs, jokes and invitations sit beside enormous theological claims.
Tim pushes the archive to stop explaining him from above and instead tell the long story through scenes, recurring people, dialogue and daily life.

Ordinary social presence becomes recoverable as its own season: games, voice chat, Great Book discussion, theology, food, music, moderation, reconciliation, rival rooms and later TTS/HTML creation lead into the April 2025 Turning without being reduced to one conflict narrative.
